review.why: Writes a 250-400 word cover letter from a resume and job description, with hook types, gap handling and a template.
review.summary: Cover letter generator: structure and length, five opening hook types and what to avoid, body paragraph formulas for the match and for gaps, a closing, a full template, adjustments by industry and scenario (referral, over- or underqualified, career change), an output format and a quality checklist.
strengths: Opening hook types with examples and a list of openings to avoid
Covers awkward cases: gaps, referral, overqualified, career change
Quality checklist to run before delivery
cautions: Instructions only: no scripts or reference files
Output format expects a match score from a job description analyzer that is not included
Example letters use invented metrics, with no rule against fabricating
